summary: Controladora Vuela Compania de Aviacion (Volaris), a Mexican ultra-low-cost carrier, filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing via press release the release of its 2025 Integrated Annual Report titled 'Ready for what's next.' The report, available on the company's investor relations website, is unaudited and explicitly disclaims any inference of future performance. This is a routine disclosure of an annual report, not a special situation. The filing contains no transaction, strategic event, or corporate action beyond the standard publication of an annual report, and no deal terms are provided.
